name: Roper Free Gifts for WooCommerce
author: Roper

sections.description:
Roper Free Gifts for WooCommerce allows you to create tiered free gift rules. Customers unlock free products when their cart subtotal reaches specified spending thresholds.

Features

  • Create unlimited tiered gift rules
  • Choose between “Choose One” or “Get All” gift rules
  • AJAX-powered gift claiming
  • Fully customizable frontend display
  • Works on product, cart, and checkout pages
  • No external services – everything runs locally
  • 100% free – no premium version
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/roper-free-gifts-for-woocommerce
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Free Gifts to configure rules
  4. Add your tier rules with products
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes, you can select any product type as a gift.

Can customers claim multiple gifts?

Rules are configured per tier. You can allow “Choose One” or “Get All” gifts per tier.

Does this call any external services?

No, this plugin runs entirely on your WordPress installation.
